elements.element: Customer owns all deliverables created for Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause does not vest ownership of deliverables in Client; it only licenses Client to use certain results of the Support Services.

elements.element: Customer owns all work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: No ownership of work product is granted to Client.

elements.element: Vendor assigns to Customer the ownership rights in deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: There is no present assignment or obligation to assign any intellectual-property rights to Client.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: TrueLink retains rights in the Interface, but the clause does not address all of TrueLink's pre-existing intellectual property and does not establish that the Interface is coextensive with that category.

elements.element: Vendor grants Customer a licence to all Vendor intellectual property embedded in the deliverables.
elements.evidence: The licence covers only “all results of the Support Services,” not Vendor IP embedded in all deliverables.

elements.element: The licence to Vendor intellectual property embedded in the deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Although the results licence is perpetual, no licence covering Vendor IP embedded in deliverables is granted.

elements.element: The licence to Vendor intellectual property embedded in the deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: Although the results licence is irrevocable, no licence covering Vendor IP embedded in deliverables is granted.

elements.element: The licence to Vendor intellectual property embedded in the deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Although the results licence is royalty-free, no licence covering Vendor IP embedded in deliverables is granted.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The narrowed licence limits TrueLink's processing of Credit Data, but there is no operative reservation stating that Client retains all ownership and other rights in Credit Data or Customer Data.

elements.element: The parties have no joint ownership of deliverables, work product, Customer Data, or related intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause neither disclaims joint ownership nor comprehensively allocates ownership of deliverables and work product.

elements.element: Vendor owns its generic tools.
elements.evidence: Ownership is reserved only for the Interface; generic tools are not identified or allocated to TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor owns its know-how.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no ownership reservation for TrueLink's know-how.

elements.element: Customer receives a licence covering all deliverables.
elements.evidence: The licence covers only “all results of the Support Services,” which is not demonstrably coextensive with all deliverables under the agreement.

elements.element: The Customer licence is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The licence to all results of the Support Services is expressly “perpetual.”

elements.element: The Customer licence is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The licence to all results of the Support Services is expressly “irrevocable.”

elements.element: The Customer licence is worldwide.
elements.evidence: The licence to all results of the Support Services is expressly “worldwide.”

elements.element: The Customer licence is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The licence to all results of the Support Services is expressly “royalty-free.”

elements.element: The Customer licence includes the right to use the licensed material.
elements.evidence: The licence expressly permits Client to “use” the results of the Support Services.

elements.element: The Customer licence includes the right to modify the licensed material.
elements.evidence: The licence expressly permits Client to “modify” the results of the Support Services.

elements.element: The Customer licence includes the right to sublicense the licensed material.
elements.evidence: The licence expressly permits Client to “sublicense” the results of the Support Services.

elements.element: The Customer licence permits exploitation of the licensed material for Customer's business.
elements.evidence: The stated use, modification, and sublicensing rights are granted “for Client's business.”

result.reason: The redline appropriately narrows TrueLink's Credit Data rights and adds several required fallback licence attributes, but it does not allocate ownership of deliverables or work product, contain an assignment, reserve all Customer Data rights, exclude joint ownership, or license embedded Vendor IP. It also fails the fallback because “results of the Support Services” is narrower or at least less certain than all deliverables, and generic tools and know-how are not allocated to TrueLink. The changes do not materially disturb unrelated support obligations or contradict Interface ownership, but the undefined scope of “results,” incomplete ownership allocation, duplicate subsection lettering, and blank support duration reduce drafting quality.
